shots.intent: 搜索首屏干净合规，一眼看清上衣加长裤的两件套结构
一秒传达天然彩棉亲肤的核心卖点，承接首屏点击
放大普通化纤内衣闷汗贴身、裤腰勒痕的不适，引出更换需求
代入孩子清晨居家穿着的松弛画面，激发安心囤货联想
微距证明肩扣做工与易穿脱结构细节
同框对比面料悬垂与手感差异，证明亲肤柔软
用空白尺码表结构消除买大买小疑虑，数值留待后期填充
一图看全杏白绿三色选择，统一布光方便比色下单
用空白徽章位与洗护图标位传递安心感，降低决策风险
收口促单，突出两件套组合与行动引导按钮

style.backgroundSystem: clean cream white #FFFFFF for packshots, soft blush pink #F6E3DC for info panels, warm oat-grey #F1EDE7 for comparison and trust screens
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons only, single sage green accent #A3B18A
style.lightingSystem: bright soft diffused studio light, gentle wraparound fill, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent soft natural baby-underwear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cream white #FFFFFF, oat beige #EFE3D0, blush pink #F6E3DC, warm grey-brown text #4A4440 and one sage green accent #A3B18A; bright soft diffused studio lighting with gentle fill and soft contact shadows; rounded modern humanist sans-serif; consistent thin-line icon style; clean gentle garment photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero angle, neat folded presentation and consistent set scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle, neat folded garment presentation, consistent set scale across the suite
style.surfaceSystem: matte cotton-textured board #F4F2EE and light oak wood #E9DFD0
